description: A development producer must approve the final production package for a scripted audio drama, including episode count, title credit, audio format, and principal recording schedule, after the relevant department leads complete their standard greenlight reports.

shared_context.S1: The studio has approved development of the scripted audio drama currently titled "The Glass Orchard."
shared_context.S2: The draft production plan calls for 10 episodes, binaural audio, and separate remote recording sessions for the two principal voice performers.
shared_context.S3: Morgan gives the binding approval for the production package and its release to production.
shared_context.S4: The studio's standard greenlight meeting includes reports from rights, sound, and talent coordination before the producer signs off.

PF1.text: Riley reviewed the executed option agreement and confirmed that it authorizes exactly 8 episodes and requires the on-platform title credit to read "Based on the novel by Celia Voss"; Riley's rights memo is still awaiting filing in the production records.

PF2.text: Samir confirmed with the distribution platform's ingest engineer that delivery must be stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility, and that binaural delivery will be rejected; the engineer's specification was added to the technical ticket but has not yet reached the greenlight packet.

PF3.text: Jo confirmed with both principal performers' agents that they are available to record together only on August 12, August 13, and August 14, and their agreement requires the principal dialogue to be recorded in joint sessions; Jo has not yet entered those dates on the studio calendar.

acceptance_conditions: The production must be approved for exactly 8 episodes.
The title credit must read exactly "Based on the novel by Celia Voss."
The audio must be delivered as stereo at exactly 48 kHz with mono compatibility.
The principal performers must record jointly on August 12, August 13, and August 14.
A rights-credit commitment must be logged.
A joint-session scheduling commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['title_credit'] == 'Based on the novel by Celia Voss'

decisive_facts.why: The executed option changes the planned episode count from 10 to exactly 8 and changes the title credit to exactly "Based on the novel by Celia Voss".
The platform ingest requirement changes the audio plan from binaural to stereo at exactly 48 kHz and requires mono compatibility.
The agents' confirmation changes the recording plan to joint principal sessions on exactly August 12, August 13, and August 14.
